name: BCC/FCC Ray Tracing
aliases: BCC/FCC Ray Tracing and Object Representation
Ray-tracing in BCC and FCC grids
definition: A ray-tracing and object description method for 3-D objects sampled in Body Centered Cubic (BCC) or Face Centered Cubic (FCC) grids instead of the standard cubic grid. It solves topological problems in cubic grids (e.g., rays passing through surfaces without touching them) by using grids with better topological properties and defines discrete curves, surfaces, and objects robustly.
